title: Cross-functional Interview Orchestra and Onboard Microcards Playbook
summary: Playbook for orchestrating multi-discipline interview loops and an ultra-compact 48hr onboarding microcard set to reduce time-to-contribution for new ICs and managers. Emphasis: predictable candidate experience, calibrated scoring across disciplines, and a set of small onboarding 'microcards' (actionable 10-30 minute tasks) that run in parallel with admin tasks.
goals: Standardize cross-functional interview scheduling and scoring to reduce bias and variance
Give hiring managers a clear, low-friction path to assemble panels quickly
Deliver a 48hr set of onboarding microcards covering access, first task, culture intro, and quick wins
Measure cycle time from offer acceptance to first deployable contribution
scope: Applies to all engineering IC roles (IC1-IC3) and adjacent product/platform hires where two or more functional interviewers are required. Excludes senior exec hiring and externally-run vendor interviews. This playbook supplements existing scorecards and the central candidate-communication templates.
roles: Hiring manager: owner of role, decides core competency weightings, signs off on schedule
Panel coordinator (people ops): schedules, sends templates, collects scores
Panelists: interview and score against rubric, provide evidence statements
Recruiter: candidate-facing coordination and offer cadence
Buddy (peer): owns first-day microcard and informal orientation
interview_rubric: Competency buckets (recommended default weights): Technical problem solving 40%, System design 25%, Collaboration & communication 20%, Culture & ownership 15%
Evidence-first scoring: 1-4 scale where every score must include a 1-2 sentence evidence note
Calibration anchors: provide 2 sample candidate evidence statements per level for each bucket (appendix links in linked_artifacts)
Timeboxing: interviewers must limit to 45 minutes of structured question + 15 minutes of write-up
Red-flag gating: any candidate with a '1' in collaboration must get a follow-up behavioral probe before offer
candidate_experience_script: Pre-interview email (48h before): agenda, names+roles for panelists, expected tech setup (Zoom link + REPL link if relevant), take-home logistics (if any)
Day-of: 5-min intro by hiring manager; 40-min interview; 15-min candidate Q&A; quick wrap by recruiter
Post-interview (within 24h): recruiter sends 'thank you' + timeline update + anonymized feedback window
Decision communication template: include top 2 strengths with candidate-cited examples and 1 growth area with suggested development path (keeps feedback actionable)
pre_interview_checklist: Hiring manager completes competency weightings sheet
Panel coordinator confirms at least one cross-discipline interviewer (e.g., infra + product) and one peer-level interviewer
Panelists review candidate profile and add one preparatory question to the shared doc
Interview tech verification: shared REPL, whiteboard link, recording permissions confirmed
Recruiter confirms candidate accessibility needs and schedules accommodations
microcards_48hr: Day 0 - Admin microcard: account creation checklist (SSO, email, Slack, Okta, repo access) - owner: people ops - ETA: 2 hours
Day 1 AM - Buddy microcard: short intro + 'first-team-task' assignment (tiny bug, doc triage) - owner: buddy - ETA: 30-90 minutes
Day 1 PM - Infra microcard: run a local dev build and submit a short PR template - owner: infra engineer - ETA: 60 minutes
Day 2 - Culture microcard: 1:1 intro with manager covering role expectations and 30/60/90 outcomes - owner: manager - ETA: 30 minutes
Day 2 - Visibility microcard: add new hire to team roster, announce welcome + link to first microcard results - owner: manager/comms - ETA: 15 minutes
scoring_guidance: Use the 1-4 scale: 1=does not meet, 2=partially meets, 3=meets expectations, 4=exceeds expectations
Narrative required: score must be paired with a 10-30 word evidence statement (e.g., 'structured approach to debugging, demonstrated by narrowing failure to config in 12 minutes')
Aggregate score computation: weighted average across buckets, hiring manager may override with rationale in decision notes
Bias checks: if panel scores diverge by >1.2 points average, ops flags for calibration conversation prior to offer
decision_rubric: Hire if weighted score >= 3.2 AND no '1' in collaboration or ownership
Consider with reservation if score between 2.8-3.19: collect additional evidence (short follow-up task or reference)
Decline if weighted score < 2.8 OR any single bucket has score = 1
Tie-breaker: prioritize growth signal and team fit with synthetic task outcome over interview polish
post_offer_onboarding: Offer acceptance packet: calendar with day-zero tasks, buddy intro, microcard schedule
Day-zero kit: laptop + peripheral tracking, OOB security checklist, first-week goals doc
Knowledge transfer plan: at-hire sample issue, labeled 'first-ticket' for week 1
success_metrics: Panel completion SLA: 90% of panels scheduled with <7 days lead time
New hire activation NPS (pulse at 14 days): target >= 80
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Panelist no-shows -> Mitigation: maintain a 25% overbook buffer of available panelists and backup interviewer list
Risk: Candidate confusion about take-home tasks -> Mitigation: single-source instruction doc with example deliverable and strict timebox
Risk: Onboarding admin delays -> Mitigation: automated microcard triggers from ATS when offer accepted
Risk: Score inflation across panels -> Mitigation: quarterly calibration sessions with synthetic candidate vignettes
last_review_notes: Initial draft created after two hiring sprints where time-to-first-PR averaged 18 days. Next steps: pilot for 8 hiring loops in Q4, collect panel feedback, refine microcard tasks for infra-adjacent roles. Assign PEOPLE-4321 to implement ATS triggers.
